article.title: France’s pouvoir d’achat crisis
article.author: Michael Roberts
article.content: The crisis in France stems from the degradation of public services under austerity, yet government debt is the result of capitalist crises, not state spending, explains Michael Roberts. The post France’s pouvoir d’achat crisis appeared first on MR Online .
